raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner confused family relations, treating the paternal grandmother as the wife of Louis, Dauphin of France (i.e., the child’s mother) instead of the mother of the Dauphin (Louis XV’s wife). This led to searching for the father’s spouse and concluding Maria Josepha of Saxony, rather than identifying Louis XV’s queen, Marie Leszczyńska, who is the correct paternal grandmother.
